"sec02-F10", "sec02-F11"], "heading": "C — Licensing Requirements (Utah Section 2)", "learner_facing": true, "markdown": "## C — Licensing Requirements (Utah Section 2)

Scope: residency triggers, exemptions, bars, equipment exception, visitor stay, single REAL ID limit, DLC and NRVC compacts. [A01]

FACT_ID: sec02-F01 | anchor: A01
Every Utah resident operating a motor vehicle on a public roadway must hold a valid Utah license, learner permit, or temporary license [A01].
Why it matters: tested eligibility distinction.
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ut-class-d:utah-dld:handbook:pdf-0014]

FACT_ID: sec02-F02 | anchor: A01
Utah treats a person as a resident after entering to make Utah home, staying six months in a calendar year, licensing or registering in Utah, taking resident-only privileges like tuition, or taking Utah employment except temporary assignment [A01].
Why it matters: tested eligibility distinction.
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ut-class-d:utah-dld:handbook:pdf-0014]

FACT_ID: sec02-F03 | anchor: A01
A six-month presence in Utah during any calendar year alone makes a person a resident for licensing [A01].
Why it matters: tested eligibility distinction.
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ut-class-d:utah-dld:handbook:pdf-0014]

FACT_ID: sec02-F04 | anchor: A01
A nonresident at least age sixteen holding a valid license from another state or country may drive in Utah [A01].
Why it matters: tested eligibility distinction.
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ut-class-d:utah-dld:handbook:pdf-0014]

FACT_ID: sec02-F05 | anchor: A01
Nonresidents on temporary assignment for an employer, religious or private organization, or government entity, and nonresident military personnel and dependents on temporary Utah assignment, may drive on a valid out-of-state or out-of-country license [A01].
Why it matters: tested eligibility distinction.
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ut-class-d:utah-dld:handbook:pdf-0014]

FACT_ID: sec02-F06 | anchor: A01
A person may not hold a Utah license if under age sixteen, if driving privilege is denied, suspended, revoked, or disqualified here or elsewhere, if unable to drive safely, if required exams are not passed, if an unsettled citation or warrant remains, if not a state resident, or if under eighteen without six months on a learner permit plus driver education [A01].
Why it matters: tested eligibility distinction.
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ut-class-d:utah-dld:handbook:pdf-0014]

FACT_ID: sec02-F07 | anchor: A01
Road rollers, road machinery, and farm tractors on Utah highways need no driver license when used in construction or agricultural work [A01].
Why it matters: tested eligibility distinction.
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ut-class-d:utah-dld:handbook:pdf-0014]

FACT_ID: sec02-F08 | anchor: A01
A visitor with a valid out-of-state or out-of-country license may drive in Utah for up to six months [A01].
Why it matters: tested eligibility distinction.
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ut-class-d:utah-dld:handbook:pdf-0014]

FACT_ID: sec02-F09 | anchor: A01
A person may hold only one REAL ID-compliant credential at a time, so a Utah license and another state's ID cannot both be REAL ID [A01].
Why it matters: tested eligibility distinction.
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ut-class-d:utah-dld:handbook:pdf-0014]

FACT_ID: sec02-F10 | anchor: A02
Utah belongs to the Driver License Compact and Non-Resident Violator Compact; the DLC shares driver records and convictions with the home state, with forty-five states plus the District of Columbia as members [A02].
Why it matters: tested eligibility distinction.
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ut-class-d:utah-dld:handbook:pdf-0015]

FACT_ID: sec02-F11 | anchor: A02
DLC nonmembers are Georgia, Massachusetts, Wisconsin, Michigan, and Tennessee; NRVC has forty-four states plus the District of Columbia, with Alaska, California, Michigan, Montana, Oregon, and Wisconsin outside it, and the home state suspends until citation terms are met [A02].
Why it matters: tested eligibility distinction.
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ut-class-d:utah-dld:handbook:pdf-0015]

High-yield rank: residency triggers, age sixteen floor, bars, visitor six-month cap, compacts membership [A01].
Misconceptions: any stay creates residency is false; military exemption is not automatic without assignment; one REAL ID limit surprises applicants [A01].
Mnemonic: HOME-Tuition-Job-Six-License tracks the five residency triggers [A01].
Glossary: resident, nonresident, DLC, NRVC, REAL ID-compliant, learner permit, temporary license [A01].", "merge_seq": 1, "section_id": "C", "source_anchors": [{"anchor_id": "A01", "source_page": "src:rdmv-ut-class-d:utah-dld:handbook:pdf-0014"}, {"anchor_id": "A02", "source_page": "src:rdmv-ut-class-d:utah-dld:handbook:pdf-0015"}]}], "stage_id": "02.dossier_sections", "verification_debt": []}
